regions.notes: S1 = Season 1 (Rabi) and S2 = Season 2 (Kharif), per the bar labels; S1 is linked to Winter Precipitation and S2 to the Monsoon. Planting bars are combined 'Land Prep, Planting' bars. Half-month edges were counted: Winter Precipitation ends mid-Apr; the Monsoon runs mid-Jun to mid-Sep; wheat harvest starts mid-Mar; wheat planting starts mid-Oct; rice harvest ends mid-Nov; maize harvest starts mid-Sep; cotton harvest starts mid-Jul; sugarcane harvest runs mid-Oct to mid-Feb; sugarcane planting starts mid-Mar; potato harvest starts mid-Jan. The dark-green bars in the 'Agricultural Labor: Harvest' row (S1 Peak mid-Mar to May; S2 Peak Jun to Dec) show labour demand, not crop harvests, so they were not listed as harvests.

assign.method: Single national calendar, so every province or territory maps to national.

transcriber_notes: Winter Precipitation is shaded in two pieces at the year edge, Dec (labelled 'Winter Precip.') and Jan to mid-Apr; recorded as one season 12-4. The sugarcane S2 harvest is likewise drawn as mid-Oct to Dec plus Jan to mid-Feb; recorded as one harvest 10-2. Cotton and sugarcane are cash crops, but the image ties them to S2, so they are linked to the Monsoon. The fruits harvest runs all year with no season link.
